_read_me: USD per second of output, keyed '<via>:<model id>:<resolution>' (or '<via>:<model id>'). Used by `film gen` to cost each take automatically. Prices move monthly: check the provider page before a production and update 'verified'. Replace the model ids with the exact ids your provider uses; an unknown key just means you pass --cost yourself.
verified: 2026-10-11 (EvoLink Seedance 2.5 rows); 2026-09-26 for the rest (research pass; see course/research/). Studio-billed rows marked [billed].
